user.title: Nooie
user.description: Point at the Nooie add-on's go2rtc server. The default works on Home Assistant OS/Supervised; if the add-on's ports are mapped to the host instead, use http://127.0.0.1:1984.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the go2rtc server at that URL.
error.no_streams: Reached the server, but found no Nooie streams. Check that the Nooie add-on is running and at least one camera is online.
